audit.name: V3 independent final procedural geometry and visual revalidation

decision.reason: All phase-1 P1 issues and six of eight P2 issues are closed or downgraded. Remaining P2 items require broad high-risk rendering or geometry work.

environment.renderer: ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) Arc(TM) Graphics (0x00007D55) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11)

phase1Adjudication.evidence: narrow drawers leave zero visible panel width initially and all six presets remain reachable
flow on/off screenshots now have a clear visible difference with branched paths
front view and source show a continuous crank-to-water-pump belt and timing drive
block and head remain dominated by rounded-box primary masses
top camera now fits the major systems between desktop panels
selection uses fitted mesh edges and inspector scroll affordance is present
section mode still uses clipping planes without cut caps
fan, pulley, sump and crank silhouettes separate from the background
draw calls fell about 28.6%, instancing is active and hardware reaches 117-120 fps
test discovery is scoped, browser semantics expanded, exploded screenshot exists and negative fixtures reject six failure classes
labels remain locally dense in narrow and section views

remainingIssues.title: Section mode lacks engineering cut caps or hatch material
remainingIssues.impact: Clipped shells read as open or hollow and material cut faces cannot be distinguished from cavities.
remainingIssues.risk: high: stencil or multi-pass caps interact with transparency, shadows, selection and draw calls
remainingIssues.acceptance: Block, head and sump have consistent cut-face treatment without floating fragments; cranktrain remains readable and all modes/performance are revalidated.

remainingIssues.title: Exterior casting silhouette remains dominated by regular rounded-box masses
remainingIssues.impact: Rich internals contrast with generic large exterior planes, limiting close-up realism.
remainingIssues.risk: medium-high: intersections, clipping fragments, unjustified styling and extra draw calls
remainingIssues.acceptance: Side and isometric silhouettes gain mechanically justified bosses, flanges and casting reliefs without obscuring internals or regressing performance and picking.

remainingIssues.title: Labels remain locally dense on narrow and section views
remainingIssues.impact: Minor visual noise on small screens and around clipped ancillary parts.
remainingIssues.risk: medium: collision avoidance can jitter or hide teaching-critical labels
remainingIssues.acceptance: No label overlap at six settled presets and 390x844; clipped parts lose labels; slight camera motion produces no visible jitter.

remainingIssues.title: Bundle and draw-call headroom remain
remainingIssues.impact: Current visible performance is excellent on hardware; residual risk is initial load and much weaker devices.
remainingIssues.risk: medium: further merging or instancing can break picking, outlines and material modes
remainingIssues.acceptance: Main chunk is split below the warning threshold or justified; draw calls fall further with all visual modes and interactions unchanged.
